profile: An acoustic folk track featuring layered acoustic guitars and emotive male vocals. The mood is reflective, earthy, and mystical, with lyrics touching on celestial imagery (moonlight, stars), the passage of time (grains of sand), and nature's cycles. The energy arc starts sparse and gentle, builds slightly as the guitar layers in, reaches a passionate, vigorously strummed peak during the second vocal section, and rides out on an energetic instrumental outro.

key_moments.what: A second acoustic guitar layer enters, enriching the instrumental texture and establishing the groove before the vocals begin.
The song reaches its energetic peak as the vocals shift to a higher, more passionate register ('Star shining bright...') and the guitar strumming becomes noticeably more vigorous and full.
The vocals have concluded, and the track shifts into an instrumental outro, changing the chord progression while maintaining the rhythmic strumming.

fitting_styles: Narrative (e.g., a mystical nighttime journey, a campfire gathering), performance (an intimate acoustic set in a forest or cozy, dimly lit room), or abstract/lyric videos using earthy tones, celestial motifs, and flowing natural elements. Approaches that would clash include high-tech sci-fi, cyberpunk, aggressive fast-paced rhythmic montages, or sterile corporate aesthetics, which would contradict the organic, acoustic folk sound.

song_checks.check: The video introduces a new visual element, character, or subtle scene change at ~6.5s to mark the entry of the second guitar.
The video increases in visual energy, brightness, or shifts to a more expansive scene at ~44.9s to match the passionate vocal delivery and vigorous strumming.
The video transitions to a concluding visual state, outro sequence, or begins to fade at ~80.1s when the instrumental outro starts.

anchors.UN: 1: The video uses a clashing sci-fi or aggressive urban style that ignores the acoustic folk genre. 3: The video fits the folk style but feels a bit generic or disconnected from the mystical themes. 5: The video embraces the acoustic, folk nature of the song with earthy, mystical, or intimate visuals that perfectly match the mood.
anchors.EM: 1: The video feels emotionally cold, frantic, or completely disconnected from the song's reflective tone. 3: The video captures the gentle mood but misses the passionate swell in the second half. 5: The video captures the reflective, mystical mood, effectively building from gentle intimacy to a more passionate, sweeping emotion.
anchors.RH: 1: The edits are random, jarring, or completely out of sync with the acoustic guitar rhythm. 3: The cuts generally follow the tempo but miss the organic push and pull of the acoustic strumming. 5: The cuts and visual movements flow naturally and organically with the acoustic guitar strumming and vocal phrasing.
anchors.ST: 1: The video ignores the song's structural shifts entirely, remaining static throughout. 3: The video responds to the major shift at 44.9s but misses the intro build or the outro transition. 5: The video clearly marks the intro build at 6.5s, the energetic shift at 44.9s, and the outro at 80.1s.
anchors.LY: 1: The imagery contradicts the lyrics (e.g., bright midday city scenes) or the text is wrong/poorly timed. 3: The imagery loosely fits the themes of nature but ignores specific motifs like the moon, stars, or time. 5: The imagery beautifully reflects themes of moonlight, stars, time (sand), and nature, or the kinetic typography is perfectly synced and styled.
anchors.VA: 1: The video uses low-effort, glitchy, or obvious placeholder visuals with poor lighting. 3: The visuals are competent but lack a cohesive color grade or cinematic polish. 5: High-quality visuals with cohesive color grading (e.g., warm earthy tones or cool moonlight blues), strong composition, and a polished look.
anchors.CR: 1: A generic, uninspired slideshow of daylight stock footage. 3: A standard acoustic performance video or basic narrative that works but takes no creative risks. 5: A unique, imaginative take on the folk/mystical theme, perhaps blending performance with magical realism or stunning abstract natural art.

checks.check: At each audible section change in the music, the picture changes in a clearly visible way that persists (not a single flash).
Prominent beats or accents are answered by visual events (cuts, hits, motion accents) for most of the clip.
Visual intensity (motion, brightness, density) rises and falls with the music's energy.
Visual rhythm is varied: not the same identical pulse on every beat for the whole clip.
The video has a coherent visual identity (consistent palette, style, or world) rather than unrelated stock effects.
No rendering defects: no tearing, black/blank stretches, placeholder text, or broken frames.
Any on-screen lyrics or words are spelled correctly and match what is sung at that moment.
The concept is recognisably about THIS song (its mood, lyrics or sound), not a generic visual that would fit any track.
